milestones.theme: Neon Vector Core, Zero-G Drift Physics & Polygon Shatter

deliverables.title: Deep-void 800x600 canvas with a reactive neon perspective warp-grid, multi-layer parallax starfield, additive glow rendering (`shadowBlur`), and a sleek single-line top arcade status ribbon (`y: 0..34`).
360-degree zero-G ship kinematics (`Left`/`Right` or `A`/`D` rotate, `Up`/`W` thrust with inertial drift, `Space` fire with recoil kickback, and seamless toroidal screen-edge wrap-around).

Procedural jagged polygon asteroid spawner with 3-tier fracturing (`LARGE` -> 2 `MEDIUM` -> 3 `SMALL` neon shards), 40ms hit-stop impact frames, camera shake, and magnetic neon score gems that burst from shattered rocks.

milestones.theme: Pixel-Art Pilot Select, Slick Glitch Transitions & Combo Overdrive

deliverables.title: Animated Neo-80s Character Selection Modal featuring the 4 playable pilots (Vex, Kaze, Bass, Nyx) with procedural pixel-art portraits, stat bars, neon scanline transitions, and distinct ship vector hulls.

Pilot weapon firing patterns (Twin Pulse, Piercing Rail, Sonic Scatter, Homing Missiles), Pilot `[SHIFT]`/`[E]` Special Ability cooldown ring rendered diegetically around the ship, and hull shield regeneration rules.
Near-miss "Graze" detection and Overdrive Combo Multiplier (`1x` to `16x`) that escalates weapon projectile size, thruster flame trails, and neon grid color cycling.

Centralized Web Audio API 128-BPM EDM/chiptune step sequencer (driving 4-on-the-floor synth kick, sawtooth bassline arpeggiator, crispy noise snare, and dynamic lead synth layers tied to combo level) plus FM laser/shatter SFX.

Between-wave "HYPER-MOD" Draft Modal offering 3 neon arcade upgrade cartridges (e.g., *Chain-Lightning Arc*, *Orbital Saw-Drones*, *Ricochet Prism Lasers*, *Afterburner Nova*) with animated card selection.
Beat-reactive visual synesthesia: the background synthwave grid, asteroid neon outlines, and starfield pulse synchronously on every 128-BPM quarter-note kick beat.

milestones.theme: Rogue Synth-Hunters, Gravity Wells & Bullet-Hell Choreography

deliverables.title: Hostile neon enemy squadron AI: Laser-Strafing Cyber-Saucers, Homing Glitch-Swarmers, and Purple Singularity Gravity Wells that curve both player lasers and asteroid trajectories.
Volatile hazard interactions: unstable Neon Plasma Barrels that detonate in chain-reaction shockwaves and directional dash-parry mechanics.
Dynamic Wave Director with diegetic on-screen warp-in warning reticles, escalating threat budgets, and combo-driven shield battery drops.

milestones.theme: Omega-Synth Dreadnought Boss, High-Score Table & Arcade Finale

deliverables.title: Multi-phase Boss Showdown ("OMEGA-SYNTH LEVIATHAN"): a massive rotating dayglo polygon dreadnought with destructible laser turrets, sweeping prism beams, and rhythmic bullet-hell patterns.

High-voltage Arcade Game Over & Victory Summary Modal featuring Synth-Rank evaluation (`S-RANK: NEON DEITY` to `D-RANK: STATIC`), pilot victory quote, persistent Top-5 High Score Leaderboard, and instant `[SPACE]` replay reset.
Slow-motion boss core meltdown explosion sequence, chromatic aberration screen flash, and victorious chiptune fanfare.

Quantum Singularity Pylons: Interactive in-arena geometric monoliths that warp local vector trajectories, slingshot projectile velocities with an additive color shift, and implode into localized shockwaves when overloaded by weapon fire.

Phasic Blink Dash & Phase-Blade Wake: An omnidirectional dash ability granting brief invulnerability frames, leaving a razor-sharp chromatic ribbon trail in the void that severs and detonates chasing hunter-class enemies on contact.

Prismatic Tessellation Shatter & Radial Shockwaves: Pure canvas-rendered visual overhaul featuring dual-frequency radial grid compression waves on heavy asteroid splits, trailing chromatic afterimage echoes behind high-velocity drifts, and reactive polygon fragmentation bursts.
